shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin surged past $77K, liquidating $585M in short positions, and the global crypto market cap rose 3%.
Perpetual futures funding rates remain negative for 46 days and the Fear & Greed Index indicates Extreme Fear at 21.
Geopolitical conditions improve with an expected Israel-Lebanon ceasefire and US equities hitting new all-time highs.
Institutional adoption grows as Bitcoin ETFs saw $332M in inflows while Morgan Stanley and Schwab advance crypto offerings.
Public Bitcoin miners sold over 32,000 BTC in Q1 2026, marking the largest quarterly liquidation wave in four years.
